scope: PHP-Wasm entry-probe documentation distinguishes the 24 copied, owned and indexed routes that count validator, constructor, adapter and Lean-source entries from the four callback routes that record callback control totals.

edits.current: Native source rejections name the declaration in `native-elaboration-unsupported`. Readers without a checked adapter reject refined metadata with `native-refinements-unsupported`. PHP-Wasm's [installed Subtype checks](../evidence/php-wasm-subtype-installed-20261010.md) cover ordinary and reviewed top-level parameters and results: twelve exports, twelve Node/Chromium configurations per route, and 2,024 checks per execution. Constructors and adapters compile with fresh Lean. Those unmodified prepared packages do not contain runtime entry counters. Separate instrumented fixture packages use 24 copied, owned and indexed routes to count named validator, constructor, adapter and Lean-source entries; four callback routes record callback control totals. Together they form 28 ordinary/reviewed routes in 26 retained artifacts without widening the consumer type surface. The [promotion workflow](https://github.com/seanmorris/lean-bridge/actions/workflows/php-wasm-refinement-entry-promotion.yml) is configured to rebuild that matrix at one revision, but no hosted count claim exists until a completed run publishes its verified summary. PHP-Wasm accepts the listed structural containers, acyclic nominal fields, [finite recursive copied graphs](../evidence/recursive-subtype-php-wasm-20261015.md), and the tested [acyclic owned record](../evidence/owned-subtype-php-wasm-local-qualification-20261022.md). The owned-record checks preserve exact constructor choices, reject an invalid transferred value before moving its resources, exercise explicit and fallback cleanup, and recover on later requests across both source routes. Refined PHP-Wasm callbacks and recursive owned graphs remain rejected. A consumer that does not declare checked support cannot read a verified refined component (`native-refinements-unavailable`). Python's [installed CI reports](../evidence/python-refinements-20261007/receipt.json) cover scalar and container `Fin`, top-level checked `Subtype`, and finite function specializations. Local acceptance does not establish a hosted CI result for a later revision.
